defmodule AuditCLI do
  @moduledoc """
  CLI tool for managing audit logs with configurable output formatting.
  Supports custom report generation via template engine.
  """

  defmodule AuditEntry do
    defstruct [:timestamp, :user, :action, :resource, :metadata]
  end

  defmodule TemplateEngine do
    @doc "Renders audit report templates with variable interpolation"
    def render(template, bindings) when is_binary(template) and is_map(bindings) do
      # First pass: resolve simple variables
      resolved = Enum.reduce(bindings, template, fn {key, value}, acc ->
        safe_value = sanitize_value(value)
        String.replace(acc, "{{#{key}}}", safe_value)
      end)

      # Second pass: resolve computed expressions for report aggregation
      resolve_expressions(resolved, bindings)
    end

    defp sanitize_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
      value
      |> String.replace("<", "<")
      |> String.replace(">", ">")
      |> String.replace("\"", """)
    end
    defp sanitize_value(value), do: to_string(value)

    defp resolve_expressions(template, bindings) do
      # Match {%= expr %} blocks for computed fields
      Regex.replace(~r/\{%=\s*(.+?)\s*%\}/, template, fn _, expr ->
        evaluate_expression(expr, bindings)
      end)
    end

    defp evaluate_expression(expr, bindings) do
      # Build a safe evaluation context with only audit-related functions
      context = build_eval_context(bindings)
      try do
        {result, _} = Code.eval_string(expr, context)
        sanitize_value(result)
      rescue
        _ -> "[ERROR: invalid expression]"
      end
    end

    defp build_eval_context(bindings) do
      # Provide bindings as variables for the expression evaluator
      Enum.map(bindings, fn {k, v} -> {String.to_atom(k), v} end)
    end
  end

  defmodule LogStore do
    use Agent

    def start_link(opts \\ []) do
      Agent.start_link(fn -> [] end, name: opts[:name] || __MODULE__)
    end

    def append(entry, store \\ __MODULE__) do
      Agent.update(store, fn entries -> [entry | entries] end)
    end

    def get_all(store \\ __MODULE__) do
      Agent.get(store, & &1)
    end

    def query(filter_fn, store \\ __MODULE__) do
      Agent.get(store, fn entries -> Enum.filter(entries, filter_fn) end)
    end
  end

  defmodule Formatter do
    @default_template """
    === Audit Report ===
    Generated: {{generated_at}}
    Total Entries: {{total_count}}
    
    {%= Enum.join(Enum.map(entries, fn e -> e.action <> " on " <> e.resource end), "\n") %}
    
    === End Report ===
    """

    def format_report(entries, opts \\ []) do
      template = opts[:template] || @default_template
      bindings = %{
        "generated_at" => DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601(),
        "total_count" => length(entries),
        "entries" => entries
      }
      TemplateEngine.render(template, bindings)
    end
  end

  def main(args) do
    {opts, commands, _} = OptionParser.parse(args,
      strict: [
        user: :string,
        action: :string,
        resource: :string,
        format: :string,
        template_file: :string,
        output: :string
      ]
    )

    LogStore.start_link()

    case commands do
      ["log"] ->
        entry = %AuditEntry{
          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
          user: opts[:user] || "system",
          action: opts[:action] || "unknown",
          resource: opts[:resource] || "unspecified",
          metadata: %{}
        }
        LogStore.append(entry)
        IO.puts("Audit entry recorded.")

      ["report"] ->
        entries = LogStore.get_all()
        report_opts = build_report_opts(opts)
        report = Formatter.format_report(entries, report_opts)
        output_report(report, opts[:output])

      ["query", field, value] ->
        entries = LogStore.query(fn e ->
          Map.get(e, String.to_existing_atom(field)) == value
        end)
        IO.inspect(entries)

      _ ->
        IO.puts("Usage: audit_cli [log|report|query] [options]")
    end
  end

  defp build_report_opts(opts) do
    case opts[:template_file] do
      nil -> []
      path ->
        case File.read(path) do
          {:ok, content} -> [template: content]
          {:error, _} ->
            IO.puts(:stderr, "Warning: could not read template file, using default")
            []
        end
    end
  end

  defp output_report(report, nil), do: IO.puts(report)
  defp output_report(report, path) do
    File.write!(path, report)
    IO.puts("Report written to #{path}")
  end
end
